note: The runtime-state register (tempdoc 737 §12c — the fork-killer, applying the execution-surface pattern from tempdoc 553/register-guard-resolution's tempdoc 576 to the AI-runtime lifecycle). The SINGLE authority for 'what is the AI runtime's desired state, observed state, and GPU-lease state' is the RuntimeStatus/RuntimeSpec/RuntimeGpuLease/RuntimeReconciler quartet in modules/app-services/.../runtimestate/. Tempdoc 737 §8d diagnosed FIVE independent vocabularies answering this question with zero derivation between them (Mode enum, the capability algebra, the wire phase/starting fields, the FE aiVerdict/aiStateStore re-derivation, the agent-palette hiding) — the exact representation-drift class this register exists to make structurally impossible going forward. Every surface here is a governed projection/consumer of the runtimestate package; a NEW production Java file that references it without being registered fails the runtime-state gate. Phase-1 scope (737 §12e): the quartet exists and is wired into bootstrap/HeadAssembly/RuntimeActivationService (this register catches THAT population); Mode/InferenceCapability/the wire view remain the PRE-migration vocabulary and are registered here as projection-pending placeholders so their Phase-2 collapse into RuntimeStatus is a governed row edit, not a silent fork (§12c items 1-3). The FE projections (aiVerdict.ts / aiStateStore.ts, §12c item 4) are OUT of this register's scope — they are already governed by the existing scripts/ci/check-ai-verdict-derivation.mjs gate (tempdoc 663, its own governance/ai-verdict-derivation.v1.json register); this register does not duplicate that FE authority, matching R7's finding that the FE single-authority gates already exist. HONEST LIMIT (mirrors 553 §5): the gate guards this DECLARED seam (runtimestate-package FQN references + the named guards); it cannot detect an undeclared fork that re-models runtime state from scratch without ever referencing the runtimestate package. Dissolution condition (737 §12c): this register retires once Mode/InferenceCapability/the wire view are deleted/re-keyed and the projection-pending rows become real registered projections or are removed.

canonicalRecord.name: RuntimeStatus
canonicalRecord.note: Observed runtime state (737 §12a), Condition-shaped per axis (ENGINE / ADOPTION / LEASE, §11a — reuses the CapabilityHealth/KEP-1623 vocabulary). Immutable snapshot; RuntimeReconciler owns the single mutable reference and swaps a fresh instance in on each observation. THE authority answering 'what is the AI runtime doing right now.'

siblingRecords.name: RuntimeSpec
siblingRecords.note: Desired runtime state (737 §12a) — the user/policy-owned, persisted answer to 'what does the user want the AI runtime to be doing' (chatEnabled + the model reference). A read projection of UiSettings, not a second authority; writes go through RuntimeSpecStore. Subsumes JUSTSEARCH_AI_AUTOSTART_ENABLED and preVduConfig (737 §12d).

siblingRecords.name: RuntimeGpuLease
siblingRecords.note: Head-side GPU lease state (737 §12a) — replaces the mode concept for GPU arbitration: chat engine and embedding work are HOLDERS of a single grant (CHAT/WORKER/NONE). Phase-1 role is a passive mirror of Mode via mirrorFromMode(); does not yet drive the MMF write or arbitrate admission.

siblingRecords.name: RuntimeReconciler
siblingRecords.note: The single writer that converges observed runtime toward RuntimeSpec ∧ policy (737 §12a). One dedicated daemon thread + a level-triggered dirty flag. The caller-forcing ArchUnit seam (RuntimeReconcilerGuardrailsTest, mirroring embeddingAutoRescueMustGoThroughEmbeddingRecoveryOps) makes §3d's never-switch-back INEXPRESSIBLE outside this class — registered as the record family's enforcement mechanism, not merely a consumer.

scan.comment: The gate auto-detects undeclared surfaces by scanning Java-main files for the runtimestate package's fully-qualified prefix — broader than an 'import X;' literal check (execution-surface's approach) because two current referencers (OrchestrationAssembly, OrchestrationPhase, HeadAssembly) use inline fully-qualified references instead of import statements. A file matches if ANY of its lines contains the prefix string, so both `import io.justsearch.app.services.runtimestate.RuntimeReconciler;` and a bare `io.justsearch.app.services.runtimestate.RuntimeReconciler reconciler` field/parameter type are caught. Only Java is auto-scanned; there is no proto/TS surface for this package yet (Phase 1 is Head-only, pre-wire).
scan.expectedMinPopulationNote: tempdoc 576 §5 vacuous-pass guard: the auto-scan must detect >= this many runtimestate-referencing files, else a renamed scan root would let the undeclared-referencer check pass vacuously. Live count is 10 (2026-07-15 Phase 2a: RuntimeActivationService, InferenceWiring, OrchestrationAssembly, OrchestrationPhase, ServicePhase, HeadAssembly, BootstrapProjections, InferenceCapabilityWiring — grew from Phase 1's 6 — plus OfflineCoordinator/OfflineCoordinatorBuilder, backfilled retroactively from Phase 2b's VDU reroute; the runtimestate package's own 5 files do not self-reference and are declared separately as canonical/carrier surfaces). Floor 3 is a conservative headroom, matching the execution-surface register's convention. Lower this with any change that legitimately shrinks the population.
